'''Pulse laser cannons,'''<ref name="BG">{{JournalCite|5|A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships}}</ref> also known simply as '''Pulse Lasers''', were [[Starship/Legends|starship]]-mounted weaponry. The [[Gorgon (INT-66)|''Gorgon'']], a modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] [[INT-66]], mounted a double pulse laser.<ref name="EL">{{JournalCite|4|Enemies for Life}}</ref> Pulse [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] were mounted on the [[HT-2200 medium freighter]] and the [[Z-10 Seeker-class scout ship|Z-10 ''Seeker''-class scout ship]].<ref name="BG" />
